brand.statement: One Platform. Every Opportunity. One Trusted Destination.
brand.promise.platform.title: One platform
brand.promise.platform.body: Jobs, training, skills testing and recruitment in one place.
brand.promise.opportunity.title: Every opportunity
brand.promise.opportunity.body: Roles in India and overseas, internships and courses, for people and organisations.
brand.promise.trusted.title: One trusted destination
brand.promise.trusted.body: Clear consent choices, and candidates never pay to see or apply for a job.
fields.identifierHint: For a mobile number, include the country code, for example +91 98765 43210.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Welcome back. Sign in to continue to Venkat Sai Global.
signIn.otp.hintBoth: We'll send a 6-digit code to your email or mobile number.
signIn.otp.hintEmail: We'll email you a 6-digit code. Codes by SMS are not available right now.
signIn.otp.hintPhone: We'll text you a 6-digit code. Codes by email are not available right now.
signIn.otp.unavailable: Sign-in with a one-time code is not available right now. Use your password instead.
signIn.notice.reset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.notice.signedOut: You have been signed out on all devices.

signUp.intent.candidate.title: Create your account
signUp.intent.candidate.description: Find jobs in India and overseas, discover training and track your applications. Creating an account and applying for jobs is free.
signUp.intent.employer.title: Create an employer account
signUp.intent.employer.description: Post jobs, share workforce requirements and manage candidates. You'll add your company details after you verify your email or mobile number.
signUp.intent.partner.title: Join as a recruitment partner
signUp.intent.partner.description: Work on assigned requirements and submit candidates. You'll add your agency details and licences after you verify your email or mobile number.
signUp.intent.institution.title: Create an institution account
signUp.intent.institution.description: List courses, run campus drives and record placements. You'll add your institution details after you verify your email or mobile number.
signUp.emailHint: We'll send a 6-digit code to verify it.
signUp.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS to verify it.
signUp.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A password is recommended; without one you sign in with a one-time code.
signUp.updatesHint: You can change these choices at any time in your account.
verify.sentEmail: We sent a 6-digit code to {target}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.sentSms: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {target}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.codeHint: Use the most recent code we sent.
verify.resendReady: You can request a new code now.
verify.resent: We sent a new code. Earlier codes no longer work.
verify.helpEmail: Can't find it? Check your spam or promotions folder. If you already have an account with this address, sign in instead.
verify.helpSms: An SMS can take a minute to arrive. If you already have an account with this number, sign in instead.
verify.expiredBody: For your security, codes are only valid for a short time. Please start again.
twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the current code for Venkat Sai Global.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
twoFactor.help: Lost access to your app and your recovery codes? Contact Venkat Sai Global support to recover your account.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.descriptionBoth: Enter your email or mobile number. We'll send you a link or a code to choose a new password.
forgot.descriptionEmail: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.emailSent: If an account uses this email, we've sent a reset link. It expires in 30 minutes.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.descriptionEmail: Choose a new password for {target}. You'll be signed out on all devices.
reset.descriptionSms: Enter the code we sent to {target}, then choose a new password. You'll be signed out on all devices.
reset.invalidBody: The link is incomplete or not valid. Request a new one.
reset.expiredBody: The link has expired. Reset links work for 30 minutes.
reset.usedBody: The link has already been used or replaced by a newer one.
reset.startBody: Request a reset link or code first. For your security, each request expires after a short time.
reset.useDifferent: Use a different email or number
account.title: Your account
account.description: Manage your name, language, time zone and how we contact you.
account.profile.title: Profile
account.profile.description: Your name is shown on applications and messages.
account.profile.nameHint: Use the name you want employers and our team to see.
account.profile.timezoneHint: Used for dates and interview times.
account.contact.title: Email and mobile number
account.contact.description: Verified contact details can be used to sign in with a one-time code and to recover your account.
account.contact.smsUnavailable: Codes by SMS are not available right now.
account.contact.verifyDescription: We'll send a 6-digit code to confirm it belongs to you.
account.contact.changeEmailDescription: We'll send a 6-digit code to the new address. The change takes effect once you enter it.
account.contact.changePhoneDescription: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS to the new number. The change takes effect once you enter it.
account.contact.passwordHint: For your security, confirm your current password.
account.contact.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {target}.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.description: Manage your password, two-factor authentication and the devices signed in to your account.
security.staffNotice.title: Two-factor authentication is required
security.staffNotice.body: Venkat Sai staff accounts must use two-factor authentication. Set it up below to continue to the Command Centre.
security.password.title: Password
security.password.description: Use a strong password that you don't use anywhere else.
security.password.noPassword: You sign in with a one-time code or Google. Add a password as another way to sign in.
security.password.othersNote: When you save, you'll be signed out on your other devices.
security.password.changedDone: Your password has been changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
security.twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
security.twoFactor.description: Add a second step when you sign in, so a stolen password is not enough to get into your account.
security.twoFactor.onDescription: Signing in needs your password (or a one-time code) and a code from your authenticator app.
security.twoFactor.offBody: You'll need an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
security.twoFactor.step1Body: Use any app on your phone that supports time-based codes (TOTP).
security.twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for adding your Venkat Sai Global account to an authenticator app
security.twoFactor.manualIntro: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
security.twoFactor.step3Title: Enter the code from the app
security.twoFactor.step3Hint: The app shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.
security.twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Confirm it's you to continue.
security.twoFactor.disableDescription: Your account will be easier to break into. Confirm it's you to continue.
security.twoFactor.staffRequired: Staff accounts must keep two-factor authentication turned on.
security.reauth.codeHint: Enter the current code from your app, or one of your recovery codes.
security.recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
security.recovery.body: Use these if you lose your phone. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe: you won't be able to see them again.
security.recovery.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
security.recovery.fileNote: Each code can be used once to sign in if you cannot use your authenticator app.
security.recovery.confirmSaved: I have saved my recovery codes in a safe place
security.connected.title: Connected accounts
security.connected.description: Sign in with your Google account instead of a password or code.
security.connected.disconnectDescription: You won't be able to sign in with Google until you connect it again.
security.connected.disconnectBlocked: Set a password or verify your email or mobile number first, so you can still sign in.
security.connected.status.linked: Google is now connected to your account.
security.connected.status.failed: We couldn't connect Google. Please try again.
security.connected.status.already_linked: That Google account is already connected to another account, or this account already has a Google account connected.
security.connected.status.unavailable: Google sign-in is not available right now.
security.sessions.title: Where you're signed in
security.sessions.description: Devices with an active session. Sign out of any you don't recognise and change your password.

security.sessions.signOutOthersDescripti: Every device except this one will need to sign in again.
security.sessions.othersSignedOut: All other devices have been signed out.
security.sessions.signOutEverywhereDescr: You'll be signed out on every device, including this one.
